LanguageData.LungCollapse.label: lung collapse
LanguageData.LungCollapse.description: Impairs breathing; further lung injuries can worsen it. Below 45% severity, decent tending permits gradual recovery once lung bleeding stops. At 45% or above, surgery is required; tending cannot repair it. Severe collapse can cause cardiac arrest.
LanguageData.LungCollapse.stages.minor.label: minor
LanguageData.LungCollapse.stages.moderate.label: moderate
LanguageData.LungCollapse.stages.tension.label: tension
LanguageData.LungCollapse.stages.severe_tension.label: severe tension
